format: liste de 6 quêtes sur la couverture puis révélation de chacune
slides: Choose your quest and I will tell you the rest...
I. Find the missing wizard / II. Investigate the screaming well / III. Explore the abandoned kingdom / IV. Absolutely do not enter this cave / V. Hunt whatever ate the moon / VI. Escort Kevin
Tableau de quêtes dans une taverne ambrée, affiches de mage, poule, dragon ; silhouette encapuchonnée.
I. Find the missing wizard
You find him beneath his tower. He's been holding the same spell for 83 years. You take his place. He goes home.
Crypte sous une tour, mage figé dans un sort lumineux.
II. Investigate the screaming well
You reach the bottom on the third night. The well is an upside-down tower. At the top, you free a dragon that hasn't seen the sky in 600 years.
Puits de pierre lumineux en clairière.
III. Explore the abandoned kingdom
You find everyone at the castle. They've been frozen in time for 400 years. You restart the kingdom's clock.
Cité abandonnée au crépuscule, rue vers un château.
IV. Absolutely do not enter this cave
You enter anyway. You return twelve minutes later. According to everyone else, 34 years passed.
Caverne rouge immense, minuscule silhouette à l'entrée.
V. Hunt whatever ate the moon
You find the beast beyond the clouds. It gives the moon back. It keeps one piece. That's why it's a crescent now.
Dragon cosmique géant au-dessus des nuages, chasseur sur un pic.
VI. Escort Kevin
You deliver Kevin after seven weeks. The king kneels when he sees him. Apparently, nobody told you who Kevin actually is.
Chevalier et poule sur un chemin fleuri vers un château.

Your Month — Your Legendary Weapon
Silhouette sur une tour au-dessus d'une cité nocturne, étoile-faisceau.
January
Moonfang — It doesn't cut armor. It cuts the magic protecting it. No spell has ever stopped the second swing.
Faux-croissant de lune, lac cyan.
February
Heart of the Wyrm — Every arrow leaves the bow as a spectral dragon. Whatever you aimed at usually stops being a problem.
Archer tirant un dragon de feu.
March
The Thousand Blades — Draw one blade and a thousand answer. You only have to choose where they fall.
Anneau d'épées spectrales au-dessus d'un château.
April
Stormcaller — Swing the hammer and the heavens swing with you. Every strike calls lightning down from the storm.
Marteau de foudre contre un démon.
May
Void Spear — Throw it into one rift. Choose where it comes out. Shields work considerably worse from behind.
Lance traversant des portails violets.
June
The Bubble Wand — One wave traps your enemies inside enchanted bubbles. The dangerous part is deciding where they float away to.
Ogres enfermés dans des bulles irisées.
July
Heavensunder — Every swing releases a blade of celestial light. Mountains, armies, monsters. It makes little distinction.
Épée lançant un arc de lumière céleste.
August
The Last Light — The closer you are to defeat, the brighter it burns. At your final breath, it becomes nearly unstoppable.
Sceptre-soleil projetant un faisceau doré.
September
Gravewake — Those slain by Gravewake do not stay down. For a little while, your enemies become your army.
Chaîne spectrale verte et crâne, armée de morts.
October
Winter's End — Strike the earth and winter answers. By the time the frost stops spreading, the battle is already over.
Hache de glace créant un cratère gelé.
November
The King's Standard — Plant the banner and a forgotten army answers the call. They have been waiting centuries for another war.
Étendard rouge planté, armée fantôme.
December
Eclipse — Every swing releases a crescent of celestial darkness. Anything caught beneath its shadow is cut clean through.
Lame-croissant noire, éclipse, démon géant.
YOUR WEAPON WAS THE EASY PART. Choose your loadout. Clear the rifts. Ascend the nine realms.

Your Month — Your Legendary Mount
Dragon blanc au-dessus des nuages.
January
Silvermaw — Runs across snow, ice, and open water. Once Silvermaw finds your trail, distance stops mattering.
Loup géant argenté courant sur un lac gelé.
February
Sir Slowsley — Nothing can stop him. Unfortunately, nothing can hurry him either.
Escargot géant portant un palanquin royal, chevaliers qui le dépassent.
March
Thunderhoof — Every hoofbeat calls down lightning. The faster he runs, the worse the storm becomes.
Destrier d'orage noir et bleu.
April
Bloomtail — Its radiant feathers strike like arrows. Being beautiful was apparently not enough.
Paon géant bleu-vert lançant ses plumes.
May
Skyswimmer — Rides the winds between kingdoms. It has never needed to land.
Raie manta céleste entre des îles flottantes.
June
Ashwing — Can dive faster than arrows can fall. Most riders only try it once.
Dragon rouge plongeant sur une citadelle en feu.
July
Grudge — Built to break battle lines. Point him toward the problem and hold on.
Sanglier cuirassé géant chargeant, ennemis projetés.
August
Sunmane — His mane burns hotter the longer he charges. Armies tend to move.
Lion aux flammes chargeant une armée.
September
The Pale Stag — Carries its rider between the living and the dead. Sometimes others follow.
Cerf squelette spectral dans un cimetière, fantômes.
October
Chestnut — Faster than most horses. Stopping him has never been successfully tested.
Coffre mimique géant à pattes, cavalier sur le couvercle.
November
Kingsclaw — Flies above even the highest peaks. Nothing in the sky willingly challenges him.
Griffon doré au-dessus d'un ravin enneigé.
December
Dreadsting — Climbs where no other mount can follow. Its stinger can punch through castle walls.
Scorpion géant escaladant une muraille.
